layout_description: Open coastal water lies to the left and foreground. A broad grassy promontory projects leftward from the connected mainland on the right, with the tiny destination on its inner tip. Preserve the promontory outline and narrow coastal indentations.
expansion_description: Extend the connected mainland, broad coastal water, irregular rocky and sandy shoreline, subdued green-brown grassland, agricultural fields and small drainage patterns. Maintain the headland and its adjoining water; do not turn it into an inland lake or duplicate the castle.
provenance: Authored approximate flat plan reviewed against frame 64 of the fresh Bamburgh flight; not surveyed or geographically registered
heading: Image top points inland/away from the arrival side; target is on the promontory
